notes: Reviewed creator profile for Anthropic. Seeds are canonical Anthropic-owned URLs; the tool describes and never fetches them.

terminology.family: Anthropic's model family is Claude, with generational lines such as Claude 3 and Claude 3.5 and tiers named Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus.
terminology.release: A dated Claude model, e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022. The tier (Sonnet) and generation (3.5) together identify a line; the date identifies the release.
terminology.tier: Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus are size/capability tiers within a generation, not separate families.
terminology.serving: Claude is served through the Anthropic API and, separately, through Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI.

naming_rules.subject: family
naming_rules.rule: The family is Claude. Record the generation and tier as attributes of the release, not as separate families.
naming_rules.example: Claude 3.5 Sonnet is the Sonnet tier of the Claude 3.5 generation.

naming_rules.subject: release
naming_rules.rule: The canonical release name is the dated API model id; the human name is an alias.

naming_rules.subject: tier
naming_rules.rule: Preserve Anthropic's tier order Haiku < Sonnet < Opus; do not translate to another vendor's tier words.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Anthropic's official news feed on its primary marketing site.
source_catalog.verification: Canonical news index reachable from the anthropic.com home navigation.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Anthropic's developer documentation; authoritative for API model identifiers and context-window limits.
source_catalog.verification: Developer documentation under the Anthropic-owned docs.anthropic.com host.

notes: Attribute every Claude release to the single Claude family; record generation and tier as attributes.
Extract API model ids only from the docs, never inferred from a tier name.
Record Bedrock and Vertex serving as separate serving-platform / deployment entities.

ambiguities.note: "Claude 3.5 Sonnet" encodes both a generation (3.5) and a tier (Sonnet).
ambiguities.guidance: Split them into structured attributes; do not treat the whole string as an opaque family name.

ambiguities.note: Anthropic publishes model cards, but their exact URL path has changed across generations.
ambiguities.guidance: Only cite a model card at a URL confirmed from docs.anthropic.com; otherwise leave the card reference empty for a human.

ambiguities.note: Bedrock and Vertex expose their own model ids that differ from Anthropic's.
ambiguities.guidance: Keep the platform-specific id on the deployment, not on the release's canonical name.
